title: Chemco Corporation — Warning Letter (Drugs/CDER)
ai_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Chemco Corporation에 관한 Warning Letter 자료에 저장된 범위의 내용만 요약합니다. 원문에 직접 확인되는 정보는 추가 사실로 확장하지 않았습니다.

summary_review.method: Codex GPT 요약 + 원문 근거 문구 자동 일치 검사
summary_review.scope: 개별 FDA Warning Letter 공식 페이지에서 추출·보관한 본문을 검토했습니다.

change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Chemco Corporation에 관한 Warning Letter 자료에 저장된 범위의 내용만 요약합니다. 원문에 직접 확인되는 정보는 추가 사실로 확장하지 않았습니다.

impact_summary.value: FDA는 Chemco의 CGMP 관리 미흡으로 제조된 의약품이 오염·품질 저하 위험에 놓였고, PRO Nail FUNGUS KILLER는 미승인 신약이며 여러 제품은 표시기재 위반으로 오표시되었다고 설명합니다. 시정이 미흡하면 압류·금지명령 등 규제 또는 법적 조치, 수출증명서 발급 보류 등이 발생할 수 있습니다.

evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding do not conform to CGMP, your drug products are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), 21 U.S.C. 351(a)(2)(B).

Failure to promptly and adequately address this matter may result in regulatory or legal action without further notice including, without limitation, seizure and injunction. Unresolved violations may also prevent other Federal agencies from awarding contracts. Failure to address violations may also cause FDA to withhold issuance of Export Certificates.

affected_work.value: Chemco Corporation의 OTC 비무균 국소 의약품 제조 및 품질관리 업무가 대상입니다. 구체적으로 장비 세척·세척 밸리데이션, 원료와 공급업체 시험·적격성평가, 품질부서 조사와 CAPA, 공정 밸리데이션 및 관리, 열거된 제품의 승인·표시기재가 포함됩니다.

evidence.quote: You manufacture topical, over-the-counter (OTC), non-sterile drug products. You have not demonstrated that your cleaning practices are adequate to remove contaminants from the shared equipment used to manufacture your drug products.

Your quality unit (QU) did not provide adequate oversight for the manufacture of your drug products. For example, your QU failed to ensure the following: Adequate investigations into out-of-specification (OOS) results that include scientific justification for the purported root cause and an assessment of impact to other batches and drug products.

“PRO Nail FUNGUS KILLER,” “SPA REDI Gelle-n-Detox Massage Lotion LAVENDER & ROSEMARY,” “SPA REDI Gelle-n-Detox Massage Lotion ICY MINT,” “Eternal Spirit Beauty HAIR PRO Anti-Dandruff, Now With Stem Cells,” “Eternal Spirit Beauty PAINLESS Pain relieving cream,” and “Eternal Spirit Beauty FUNGI FRESH Anti-fungus Liquid for Fingers & Toes”

recommendation.value: FDA는 위반사항의 원인을 조사하고 재발 및 다른 위반의 발생을 예방하며 이를 신속히 시정하라고 요구합니다. 서신 수령 후 서면으로 조치 내용과 재발 방지 내용을 답변하고, 15영업일 안에 시정을 마치지 못하면 지연 사유와 완료 일정을 제시해야 합니다. 또한 적격한 컨설턴트를 활용해 운영을 평가하고 CGMP 준수를 지원할 것을 권고합니다.

evidence.quote: You are responsible for investigating and determining the causes of any violations and for preventing their recurrence or the occurrence of other violations. Correct any violations promptly.

After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence. In response to this letter, you may provide additional information for our consideration as we continue to assess your activities and practices. If you cannot complete corrective actions within 15 working days, state your reasons for delay and your schedule for completion.

Based upon the nature of the violations we identified at your firm, you should engage a consultant qualified as set forth in 21 CFR 211.34 to evaluate your operations and to assist your firm in meeting CGMP requirements.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.

practical_review.scope: 확보한 본문 기준 · 첨부 및 미확보 페이지는 제외 · 자동 추출
